items.title: Derek Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 5, 2021
items.q: Actually Jody Espina of Jody Jazz made me a specific mouthpiece, they call it the DB Beatbox

ctx.x: Did you have to fuss with your gear so that your gear helped you get where you wanted to go with the way you play?

Yeah a little bit. I mean I love saying that like man, it’s the player that makes the music, it’s not getting the right gear that’s going to make you sound better. That is so, so true. And I could do this BeatBox stuff on any horn. But there are certain things that maybe this Jody Jazz mouthpiece is a little easier, or I like the feeling of the New Mechanics. There are some small things like the fact that, this would get really technical, I won’t go all the way there, but when you slap tongue on the sax, my…
So if you had five minutes before going to babysit your kids and you’ll —
